name: web_page_coords
description:
web_page_coords:

Take a screenshot of the current page, analyze it visually, and return:
- a short visual description of what’s on screen
- any blockers/modals/overlays that may be intercepting clicks
- suggested next steps
- optional coordinate targets (x,y) for obvious clickable controls (accept cookies, close modal, primary CTA)

This should be your DEFAULT page-understanding tool for Playwright MCP browsing (JS-heavy sites).
Use it before most clicks and any time a modal/overlay might exist.
